_note: Random cast distribution for when the initial prompt names no count. MEASURED, not invented, and PER MODE because the two boorus genuinely differ: 1,200 random posts sampled from each (2026-08-28), classified by their own count tags. Gelbooru is the authority for anima (its relation vocabulary is native: 1futa, futa_with_female, ...), danbooru for illustrious. the author's rules: no cap on cast size, randomness follows the real rarity of the content; 'no humans' is never rolled randomly (reachable only when the prompt asks or the user forces it); a count stated in the prompt is never overridden. Weights renormalised after excluding 'no humans' and posts with no count tags.

futa._note: danbooru has no futa count axis (futanari is a general tag, 0.43% of the corpus): futa stays an OVERLAY here -- with this probability one rolled female becomes futa, counted among the girls, plus the futanari tag.

futa_detail._note: The futa class is spice-conditioned and split by relation, all from gelbooru's own EXACT counts (not the sample) -- 99,351 futanari posts against 14,126,840 total. Futa content is 3.63% of explicit posts and 0.17% of questionable, so the class weight above (the sample's 1.1%) is replaced at roll time by the value matching the resolved spice level. Relation shares overlap on real posts (a futa_with_female post can also be multiple_futa); they are normalised as draw weights.

_class_notes.1girl + viewer: one girl tagged, no second count tag, not solo: someone off-screen. Maps to a typed-pov or solo-focus cast. 10.8% on gelbooru vs 7.1% on danbooru -- the pov-heavy booru is the explicit one.
_class_notes.1boy + offscreen: same shape for a male subject.
_class_notes.large mixed group: the measured micro-tail merged: every 3+N combination that appeared once or twice. Drawn as a class, then a concrete combination is rolled inside it, so the tail stays reachable without pretending 1-post precision.
